NOORDWEEB / GOOD TO KNOW

Your details, handled simply.

This notice describes the current private preview. Business contact details and any policies for handling received enquiries need to be completed before public launch.

What happens to your brief

The name, business name, email and message you enter are used in your browser to prepare a project brief. This website does not submit that form to a server or save it in a database. Your form details are not written to browser storage by this site.

Downloading a brief creates a text file on your device. Copying it writes it to your clipboard. If you choose to send it by email, the message is handled by your email service and the recipient. Nothing is sent automatically.

Cookies, images and fonts

The page does not add analytics, advertising cookies or tracking pixels. Its photographs and fonts are hosted with the site. The hosting service may process technical requests, security logs or sign-in information needed to serve this private preview.

Who is behind the site

NoordWeeb is the intended business name for this project under Tæknistoð ehf., Iceland. Registration and public contact details are to be confirmed before launch.

A public contact address has not yet been configured. This private preview does not accept enquiry submissions.

When the site changes

If enquiry delivery, analytics, payment or booking services are added, this notice must be updated to explain what information those services receive and how it is used.
